affectedRepoFiles: registry/untitledui/components/application/date-picker/date-range-picker.tsx (AriaDateRangePicker, AriaDialog, AriaGroup, AriaPopover, useLocale, useDateFormatter, useControlledState, endOfMonth/endOfWeek/startOfMonth/startOfWeek/today/getLocalTimeZone from @internationalized/date, DateValue)
consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT — the hardest blocker in this file group, since range selection has no partial workaround (no two-calendar primitive, no range-aware field).
notableDifferences: Range selection state in React Aria is {start, end} of DateValue with range-aware cell styling (isSelectionStart/isSelectionEnd/in-range); Base UI exposes nothing range-shaped.
`useLocale` (react-aria-components) for locale/direction and RAC's range-aware formatting have no Base UI counterpart in this area.
